assumptions.choice: Set minimum required prior occurrences N = 1
assumptions.reason: The specification states 'fewer than N prior occurrences' without defining N explicitly. Setting N=1 requires at least one completed same-calendar-month historical return before taking a position.

assumptions.choice: Evaluate intramonth stop loss against bar Low for longs and High for shorts, closing position via self.close()
assumptions.reason: The specification defines stop thresholds as price <= entry*0.98 for longs and price >= entry*1.02 for shorts. Checking intra-bar extreme prices (low/high) captures price touches during 15-minute bars.

assumptions.choice: Remain flat when no prior same-month history exists in the data feed
assumptions.reason: The dataset spans May 2026 to August 2026. Because each calendar month appears only once in this feed, there are 0 prior occurrences of the same calendar month available at any point, resulting in insufficient history and zero trades per strict spec rules.
